attacks.name: Chaos Bomb
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each Darkner on your opponent's Field (Do not apply weakness or resistance to those Darkners).

attacks.name: Violent Transit
attacks.text: Switch this Darkner with 1 Darkner on your Field.

abilities.name: Relentless Stampede
abilities.text: Whenever you damage 1 of your opponent's Darkners using an attack from your Battling Darkner, flip a coin. If heads, place 1 damage counter on every Darkner that was damaged by that attack.

attacks.name: Refreshing Splash
attacks.text: Use 25% TP. If you do, heal 20 damage from each Darkner on your field.

abilities.name: Vow of Majesty
abilities.text: As long as this Darkner is in the Battle Zone, prevent all damage done to Darkners on your Field by attacks from your opponent's Battling Darkner.

attacks.name: Flash Melt
attacks.text: If this Darkner has 5 or more energy attached, this attack does 80 more damage. Shuffle all energy attached to this Darkner into your deck.

attacks.name: Overrun
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage for each Cuptain you have in play.

abilities.name: Selfless Devotion
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack) you may use this ability. Place 2 Damage Counters on this Darkner. If you do, attach 1 Basic Energy from your discard pile to 1 Darkner on your field.

attacks.name: Quick Selfie
attacks.text: Discard all energy cards attached to this Darkner. Put 2 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Darkners. If your opponent's Darkner is knocked out by this attack, take another turn after this one. If 1 of your Darkners used Quick Selfie during your last turn, this attack can't be used.

attacks.name: Showtime!
attacks.text: This attack costs 1 Energy less for each Darkner on your Field.

abilities.name: Captive Audience
abilities.text: As long as this Darkner is in your Battle Zone, you cannot play any non-Evolution Darkners onto your Field from your hand.

attacks.name: Reckless Shatter
attacks.text: Discard the top card of your deck. If you do, discard the top 2 cards of your opponent's deck.

abilities.name: Pure Darkness
abilities.text: You can only play this Darkner if you have 3 or more Titan Spawn in play.

attacks.name: Bump
attacks.text: Switch out your opponent's Battling Darkner to their Field (Your opponent chooses their new Battling Darkner).

abilities.name: Hazy Memory
abilities.text: Whenever this Darkner is knocked out during your opponent's turn, you may use 25% TP and put it into your hand instead of your discard pile.

attacks.name: Recruit
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Darkner and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

abilities.name: Creative Liberties
abilities.text: When you play this Darkner from your hand onto your Field, you may use this ability. Both players shuffle their hands into their decks and draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Creative Liberties ability during your turn. You can't use this ability on your first turn.

attacks.name: Colourful Legacy
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each different type of Darkner on your Field.

attacks.name: Helpful Training
attacks.text: Attach a Basic Energy card from your hand to 1 Darkner on your Field.

abilities.name: Luring Incense
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Darkner from your hand onto your Field, you may use this ability. Search your deck for a non-Evolution Darkner (except any Balthizard) and put it onto your Field. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Luring Incense ability during your turn.

attacks.name: Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

abilities.name: Way of the Worm
abilities.text: Once during your turn, you may discard a Basic Energy card from your hand in order to draw 1 card. You can't use more than 1 Way of the Worm ability during your turn.

attacks.name: Close Tab
attacks.text: Shuffle this Darkner and all cards attached to it into your deck.

abilities.name: Click Here!
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Darkner from your hand onto your Field, you may use 25% TP. If you do, search your deck for a Lightner card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. You can't use more than 1 Click Here! ability during your turn.

name: Petal Feather
text: Switch your Battling Darkner with 1 Darkner on your Field.

name: Glowshard
text: Search your deck for a basic energy card, put it into your hand, then shuffle your deck.

name: Sharp Knife
text: Search your deck for an Area card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: CD Bagel
text:
You may only use this card if you discard 1 other card from your hand.
Search your deck for up to 2 basic energy cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Recruit Manual
text:
You may only use this card if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.
Search your deck for a Darkner and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Revive Mint
text: Put a Darkner from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Kris
text: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.

name: Susie
text: Switch in 1 Darkner from your opponent's Field to their Battle Zone.

name: Napstablook
text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Berdly
text: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck, then they each draw 4 cards.

name: Temmie
text: Draw 3 cards.

name: Sans
text: Discard your hand and search your deck for up to 2 ACT cards, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Mewers Live
text: The TP cost of all Spell cards that cost 50% TP or less is increased by 25%.

name: Cyber City
text: The Flee cost of all Darkners in play is 1 energy more, except for any {Electric} Darkners.

name: Second Sanctuary
text: Both player's Battling Darkners have their weaknesses and resistances swapped.

name: Dark Zone
text: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard 2 cards from their hand. If they do, they draw a card.

name: Cold Place
text: Whenever any player puts a non-Evolution Darkner onto their Field during their turn, place 1 damage counter on that Darkner.

name: Rude Buster
text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a basic energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Darkners and discard it.

name: Revive Song
text: Put either a basic energy card or a Darkner from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Workshop
text: Attach a Basic Energy card from your discard pile to 1 non-Evolution Darkner on your Field that doesn't have an ability or any energy cards attached.
